previous_snapshot: round002-p0 is preserved in code commit ae051a79359c4e0be9658d89452c05793d64d831 and smoke001 manifest; no scored output was observed before this revision.
source_feasibility_update: source-feasibility-notes.json records attributable upstream human review for miniF2F-v2c and ProofNet-Verified. A separate owner-performed review is not intrinsically required. No source is admitted until exact statements, legal acquisition, runtime and answer-proof binding are qualified.

original_proposal.status: retained proposal only; not an acquired or human-reviewed panel

seed_policy: Use seed 0 first; seeds 1 and 2 only after qualified smoke and budget reservation. Sampling seeds are separate from mandatory PYTHONHASHSEED=0 startup.
panel_size_rule: Decide a feasible size from lawful source availability, statement fidelity and non-scoring smoke cost before any scored target-model output. Record a new protocol/panel version before reducing the proposed size. Do not select, replace or remove questions after observing scored outputs.

source_candidates.acquired_scope: README, LICENSE, lean-toolchain and lake-manifest.json only; no benchmark solution collection
source_candidates.answer_visibility: must be classified per statement before selection; a result embedded in the theorem is answer_given
source_candidates.reason_not_frozen: No statement-only acquisition and exact per-item fidelity record was completed; upstream port warns that it is not regularly maintained. An existing benchmark name does not establish this task's per-statement fidelity.

Conservatively excluded in favor of alternative sources. No public generated proofs is explicit; construing all private automated evaluation as requiring prior contact was an earlier interpretation, not a license prohibition. See source-feasibility-notes.json. No contact is authorized.
Agent-authored control statements are not human-reviewed benchmark problems or model capability evidence. No control passes may replace a scored denominator.

answer_rules.pure_proof: answer_status=not_applicable; excluded from answer-discovery and joint denominators
answer_rules.answer_given: May contribute only to proof rate; never claim the provided answer was found
answer_rules.answer_discovery: Answer must be absent from proposer/refiner/retrieval inputs; joint success requires a correct discovered answer and a verified proof for the fixed original statement

freeze_gates: A lawful statement-only source and complete per-item provenance are available without acquiring public benchmark solutions
Already human-checked formal statements are supported by attributable review evidence; preserve hypotheses, types, domains, quantifiers and goal
All selected statement and dependency fingerprints, exposure and answer visibility are recorded
The trusted Lean worker passes positive/negative controls and measured isolation before arbitrary candidate execution
The fixed model, tokenizer, dependencies, prompt template, dtype, sharding and sampling settings pass non-scoring TPU v5e-8 smoke
Measured smoke cost establishes shared M-SAMPLE/M-REPAIR token, tool and wall ceilings within remaining reserved submission budget
The protocol and panel are committed and hashed before scored output is generated
blocked_metrics: No complete-proof rate is estimated because no scored panel was frozen or run
No answer-and-proof joint success is estimated because no eligible answer-discovery items were qualified
No feedback-versus-independent-sampling effect is estimated from engineering controls
failure_accounting: Once frozen, retain every planned item and seed in end-to-end denominators, including timeout, invalid_format, infrastructure_error, unknown and not_reached. Report exact completed subsets separately without removing incomplete items.
